integrity: A uniform analytic proof establishes the rank-two pair-sum bound and sharp equality classification; finite standalone checks corroborate normalization and small-field cases without claiming infinite certification.
scientific_limitations: Applies to nondegenerate homogeneous binary quadratic forms on even finite fields and nonzero levels; output uses unnormalized counting measure. It does not address zero-level or higher-dimensional cases. An equivalent historical Sidon-language statement remains possible.
title: Phase-rigid sharp Fourier extension for binary-field quadratic conics
